values.note: Electric-only sites (20/30 amp, rigs up to 35 ft) $34 Sunday to Thursday and $39 Friday and Saturday, or $36 and $41 from June through September; full-hookup sites $47 and $50, or $49 and $52 from June through September; by the week $209 and $285. note: City of Silver Bay campground on Lake Superior's North Shore, beside Black Beach Park and a short walk from the beach. It opened in 2020, so the trees are still young and shade is thin. Sites 1-15 are electric only and take rigs up to 35 ft; sites 16-25 sit on a main city road. The dump station is in town, on Shop Hill Road. An ATV trail can be reached from the campground. The nearest boat launch is at the Silver Bay Marina, about 5 miles south. --Claude
summary: City site, FAQ and Google read: 49 sites (34 full hookup 20/30/50, 15 electric-only), $34-52 plus tax unchanged, Campspot booking, open May 15 to October 15 (was 05-15..10-10 from Campspot's closure calendar). Phone added. Proposed waterfront upgrade lakeview -> coastal walk. ATV trail access flagged.
flags: WATERFRONT (proposed upgrade, lakeview -> coastal walk): Black Beach on Lake Superior lies about 150 m SE of the east (upper) loop (around 47.2988,-91.2458) and about 450-500 m from the west row, reached through city park land on the campground's own access road (Lakeview Drive into Black Beach Park); Hwy 61 and the town lie to the west and north, not between; no rail line or housing crosses the walk on the imagery. The city: 'Walking distance to Black Beach', 'Direct access to Black Beach Park on the North Shore of Lake Superior', 'Black Beach is found just a short walk from the campground'. No site is within ~50 m of the water, so no on-water value; the existing lakeview evidence (open view from the E loop) still stands if coastal walk is declined. apply.py does not write waterfront.

OHV (flag, not a drop): the city lists 'Direct access to local and state ATV trails from your campsite' and the FAQ says 'You can access the ATV trail from the campground.' It is a general municipal campground beside a public beach, so it reads as a general campground with an OHV side, not a staging camp.
